reference_usage: Preserved reference only; not used as bearing inputs

inputs.strength_source: Prescribed synthetic su=50 kPa, phi=0 and gamma=18 kN/m³; no site strength data
inputs.geometry_source: Synthetic ideal infinite surface strip, B=2 m, Df=0 m
inputs.groundwater_source: Groundwater/pore-pressure correction explicitly excluded in this synthetic idealization
inputs.load_source: Synthetic vertical concentric line load=150 kN per metre
inputs.factor_source: Synthetic declared global factor=3 on net ultimate; no code factor or safety approval
inputs.applicability: Homogeneous phi=0 undrained infinite half-space; rough horizontal rigid surface strip; level ground; vertical concentric loading only; no groundwater correction.

result.formula: Surface infinite strip: qu_net=su*(pi+2); Nq=1; Ngamma=0; q0=gamma*Df=0. qu_gross=qu_net. qallow_net=qu_net/declared global FS; qallow_gross=qallow_net+q0. Resistance per metre=q*B. Applied q=vertical line load/B.
result.units: su,q in kPa=kN/m²; B,Df m; gamma kN/m³; vertical load/resistance kN/m; moment kN·m/m
result.reference_note: FHWA GEC 6 (2002), printed pp.51-53 / PDF pp.57-59, equations 5-2/3/4 and Table 5-1: strip factors Nc=2+pi, Nq=1, Ngamma=0 at phi=0; rounded table Nc=5.14. Corroborated by USACE EM 1110-2-2502 (1989), equations 5-3a/b/c/d.
limitations: Ideal infinite surface strip only, not rectangular/square CAD footings
Homogeneous phi=0 total-stress idealization; explicit sourced synthetic su, no strength inferred from E or unit weight
Groundwater/pore-pressure corrections excluded; exclusion is not a site groundwater observation
No embedment, eccentricity, inclination, shear, layered soil, slope or adjacent footing effects
Strength-only allowable reference with declared global FS; settlement and site suitability not checked
Failure mechanism display is an illustrative schematic, not a computed collapse field
No Winkler/contact or elastic settlement result is used; no IS/US compliance or safety approval
